permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: appearance-preview-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    # Metadata changes do not alter admission. Gate only source-head lifecycle
    # events so title, labels, milestones, and draft promotion cannot create
    # redundant queue work.
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

concurrency:
  group: source-gates-${{ github.ref }}
  # Superseded PR heads cannot qualify the current source; do not queue behind them.
  # Release routing and manual runs keep their existing serialization.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# `release-ready` is the single required status on protected `main`. Do not add
# pull-request path filters above: a filtered workflow leaves a required check
# pending forever. Maintenance is classified in preflight and exits quickly.

pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types:
      [
        opened,
        reopened,
        synchronize,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
        milestoned,
        demilestoned,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
      ]

concurrency:
  group: fastline-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number || github.run_id }}
  # Metadata changes are cheap and read current state. Serializing them avoids
  # cancelled controller checks poisoning GitHub's merge-state rollup.
  cancel-in-progress: false

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      [opened, reopened]

concurrency:
  group: stage-unallocated-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

pathFilterConclusion: A documentation-only commit does not make this source-changing PR documentation-only. GitHub evaluates pull_request path filters against the complete three-dot topic-branch diff. These existing matched source paths remain in the PR; source-gates has no path filter at all.
concurrencyConclusion: Appearance preview, Company candidates and Industrial features key concurrency by PR number and cancel-in-progress=true. Source validation keys by the PR merge ref and also cancels superseded PR runs. A new synchronized head can replace/cancel the pending or active run in each corresponding group, discarding its current queue position.
